tickets.title: Prepare liquidity planning analysis
tickets.text: Review expected cash needs, emergency reserve targets, recurring income sources, upcoming distributions, and potential funding sources for Mira Thimblefern’s business sale proceeds. Summarize recommended cash cushion, any portfolio trades needed to raise cash, tax considerations, and questions for the lead advisor before client discussion. Show how much sale cash should remain available for taxes, household reserves, mortgage decisions, charitable gifts, and staged portfolio reinvestment.
tickets.evidence: Mira asked for an analysis showing how much sale cash should remain available for taxes, household reserves, mortgage decisions, charitable gifts, and staged portfolio reinvestment; the agreed follow-up is due September 5, 2025.

tickets.title: Obtain business sale closing documents
tickets.text: Obtain the final closing statement, escrow schedule, and post-closing adjustment worksheet for Mira Thimblefern’s sale of her 80% membership interest in Paper Otter Packaging LLC. Add the documents to her planning file so net proceeds and escrow treatment can be verified.
tickets.evidence: the final closing statement, escrow schedule, and post-closing adjustment worksheet were not yet in Mira’s planning file, and those documents are needed to verify net proceeds and escrow treatment by August 29, 2025.

tickets.title: Trace net proceeds variance
tickets.text: Trace the difference between the broker’s estimated net cash proceeds and the $3.71 million actual incoming wire to Mira Thimblefern’s Teacup Comet Bank checking account. Identify fees, debt payoff, escrow, or a separate expected transfer responsible for the variance.
tickets.evidence: the broker’s proceeds memo showed a higher estimated net cash amount than the actual incoming bank wire, and the difference needs to be traced to fees, debt payoff, escrow, or a separate expected transfer by August 27, 2025.

tickets.title: Coordinate estimated tax planning with Tobin Mossbutton
tickets.text: Coordinate with Mira Thimblefern’s CPA, Tobin Mossbutton of Apricot Compass Tax, to compare sale proceeds, consulting income, withholding, and expected deductions before the next estimated tax planning decision.
tickets.evidence: Mira wants the advisory team and Tobin Mossbutton to compare sale proceeds, consulting income, withholding, and expected deductions before the next estimated tax planning decision; the agreed follow-up is due September 12, 2025.

tickets.title: Collect health coverage details for Mira Thimblefern
tickets.text: Collect premium, deductible, and eligibility details for replacement health coverage for Mira Thimblefern before she chooses an option. Her former company coverage is expected to end after the transition period.
tickets.evidence: premium, deductible, and eligibility details for replacement coverage are needed before choosing an option by September 20, 2025.

tickets.title: Follow up on Teacup Comet Bank transfer hold
tickets.text: Follow up with Teacup Comet Bank on the temporary hold limiting outbound online transfers from Mira Thimblefern’s checking account that received the sale wire. Address the bank’s restriction on efficient movement of excess cash to custody or treasury vehicles.
tickets.evidence: Mira reported that Teacup Comet Bank temporarily limited outbound online transfers from the account that received the sale wire, preventing efficient movement of excess cash to custody or treasury vehicles; the agreed follow-up is due August 25, 2025.

tickets.title: Update Mira Thimblefern’s estate file
tickets.text: Update Mira Thimblefern’s estate file to reflect the sale of her 80% membership interest in Paper Otter Packaging LLC. Obtain current signed copies of any post-sale amendments or fiduciary updates and replace the record’s reference to the operating business interest.
tickets.evidence: the estate file on record still references the operating business interest and lacks current signed copies of any post-sale amendments or fiduciary updates; the agreed follow-up is due September 10, 2025.
